## Intent — what this is for

Research draft T05. Loops lack cost and wall-clock ceilings and stop reasons are free text, so nothing downstream can act on WHY a loop stopped.

## Done when

LoopStopReason is a closed enum persisted on the run record; loops accept optional wall-clock deadline + max_cost and stop with the corresponding reason when exceeded; ceilings wired through config round-trip points; tests cover each stop reason incl. deadline and cost trips; existing free-text consumers migrated.
